notes.title: Update Notes (version 2.1)
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

It has been around two months since the release of TaskPals 2.0. I have been fixing bugs reported in the Steam Discussions and the Discord bug report channel. If you find or think something is a Bug, feel free to post it in Discussions or on Discord, your help is very appreciated!

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Pals glitching in the air if their behavior was changed while they were falling.
[*]  Added a green border to the selected Pal’s icon in the menu to improve visibility.
[*] Added an icon to the menu window.
[*]  The app should now be hidden from Discord's "Stream Screen."
[*]  Some tooltips had their last letter cut off.
[*]  The stacked monitors issue has been fixed.
[/list]

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*]  A new option, "Force Border," is now available. Many users didn’t like how Pals could move beyond their borders. With this option enabled, they will not leave the border zone on their own. If you take them out, they will immediately return.
[*]  A new option, "Display Settings," is now available. Here, you can disable certain screens that you don’t use or that overlap with others. If you have multiple screens, disabling the ones you don’t use can also improve the app’s performance. Note: You cannot drag Pals across disabled screens.
[/list]

[h2]Plans for the future[/h2]
[list]
[*]  Localization is something I have been working on and should be released in the next couple of months.
[*] A tutorial for new users.
[*] Performance optimizations.
[*]  Different rendering options depending on the Pal’s drawing style.
[*] Pal competitions.
[/list]

[h2]Final words[/h2]
The next update will definitely include improvements to optimization and rendering. Also while I am doing this I am preparing translations for TaskPals so when the time comes to implement Localization, everything is ready. 
Thats it! Thanks for your time and enjoy TaskPals!

notes.title: Major update is available
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

The new version with long-awaited changes is finally here! Here’s a list of the most important updates:
[list]
[*] Workshop support and editor: You can now download user-created Pals from the Steam Workshop or create your own directly within the TaskPals app.
[*] Multiscreen support: If you have multiple monitors, you can move Pals seamlessly between screens.
[*] Reworked interaction system: You can now drag and throw Pals around your screen with the left click, and pet them with the right click. (Note: heart particles have been removed.)
[*] New user interface: A fresh look to enhance your experience.
[*] As I have limited hardware and knowledge, there might be things I’ve overlooked. I kindly ask for your patience with any bugs you encounter, and I’ll do my best to address them as soon as possible.
[/list]

[h2]Plans for the future[/h2]
[list]
[*] New tutorial: A detailed guide on how to use TaskPals and create new Pals.
[*] Pal competitions: I’m planning to organize a few competitions to showcase the best user-created Pals.
[*] Performance optimizations: I’m currently testing a new rendering method for TaskPals. While it’s an improvement, I’m still not satisfied with the resource usage. Further optimization is a priority.
[*] Modular behaviors: I’m exploring the idea of adding customizable behavior options for Pals during creation.
[/list]

[h2] Ideas and Feedback [/h2]
If you have any ideas or feedback, feel free to send a message to our Discord channel or post a thread at Discussion forum!

[h2]Final words[/h2]

Wow, this update was harder to complete than I expected! I’m sure there are still some obvious bugs I haven’t caught, but I’ll fix them as soon as you report them. 😊
Other than that, I hope you all enjoy this update as much as I do. Thank you for being part of this growing community and for your continued support of my work!

notes.title: New version is coming!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone[/h2]

notes.title: UPDATE regarding False-positive virus detection
notes.notes:
[h2]BIG (GOOD) NEWS![/h2]
[h3]Dear pals,[/h3]

I have an important update regarding the recent false virus flag issue that some of you encountered while using TaskPals. I deeply apologize for any concern or inconvenience this may have caused you over the past month and a half. And I am thankful for your trust and patience!

[h3]What Happened?[/h3]

During this period, my app was mistakenly flagged as a potential security threat by certain antivirus programs, leading to false alarms. This was entirely unintentional and not the result of any malicious activity on our part. One of the main reasons for this was the fullscreen detection method that the app used, which the antivirus program mistaken for something harmful and bad.

[h3]Resolution[/h3]

I am pleased to inform you that the issue has been successfully resolved. I worked diligently with antivirus software providers to ensure our app is recognized as safe. 

[h3]Our Commitment[/h3]

Your trust is of utmost importance to me, and I am committed to ensuring your security and satisfaction. I will continue to monitor our app's performance, taking proactive steps to prevent similar issues in the future. However, if something similar happens in the future, I should be able to solve it faster.

[h3]How to Help[/h3]

If you encountered the false virus flag issue, please update your app to the latest version, which includes the necessary fixes. Also, if you encountered a false-positive alert on your PC, You will probably have to update your Windows Defender drivers and clear the cache for them.
How to clear the Microsoft Defender cache:
1. Open command prompt as administrator and change directory to c:\Program Files\Windows Defender
(COPY & PASTE INTO CMD(no quotation marks): "cd c:\Program Files\Windows Defender"
2. Run (COPY & PASTE): “MpCmdRun.exe -removedefinitions -dynamicsignatures”
3. Run  (COPY & PASTE):"MpCmdRun.exe -SignatureUpdate"

If you have any lingering concerns or questions, feel free to reach out via email at [b]taskpalshelp@outlook.com[/b].

[h3]What next?[/h3]

I will be focusing more on creating new packs and adding new TaskPals for you to play with. There will be one new pet coming to the free pack as my way of saying thanks to all of you. Halloween is also approaching; maybe there will be some spooky surprises. Who knows?
Also, I will try to fix as many bugs as possible that were reported. Development will be slowed as I need to take extra care with releasing and testing the app in the hope that something like this doesn't happen again.

I appreciate your ongoing support and understanding as I work to provide you with a better and smoother experience with TaskPals. And once again I am very thankfull for all patience you have given me!

[h2]Thank you for being a part of our community.[/h2]

Have fun!

notes.title: Update with the Microsoft and false-positive Virus flag
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. 

First, I am sorry because I have not posted in a while. Here I am now, unfortunately with some bad news. I had no luck with Microsoft. As far as I can tell, my application was submitted and processed automatically, which resulted in it being flagged as a virus again. I am trying to fix the problem, find and change the part of the code that was detected as a virus, but I am not sure how long that will take, as I have lost motivation because all my effort and time was basically for nothing... If you think you could help, or you had experience with this before, feel free to contact me.

I cannot and will not ask you to believe my words. If you do not believe it, there are plenty of other virus tests online that see no problems with my application. So if you like the application, you can whitelist it in your antivirus settings and use it as you always have.
Here is a link to the VirusTotal website with the results about TaskPal:
https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/44fb4d74a6902f007a76150c3a241a4d28a87f3e69afa314c81604fbf6938c7f/detection
